description: Preserving the body and its individual parts through mummification or depiction, as with this funerary mask, was essential to life after death in ancient Egypt. Potent symbols, such as the amulets shaped like anatomical hearts strung around the neck of the mask, provided an extra layer of protection. For ancient Egyptians the heart—not the brain—was the center of thought and emotion.
title: Funerary Mask
